case.title: Ransomware outbreak on student management database server
case.attack_vector: Compromised SSH credentials via external brute force leading to lateral movement and malicious payload execution
case.financial_impact_estimate: Zero direct ransom paid; temporary portal downtime of 32 minutes

organization.name: Kumaraguru College of Technology
organization.address: Athipalayam Road, Chinnavedampatti, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641049
organization.dpo_title: Data Protection Officer & Head of IT

steps.title: Isolate the Host from the Network
steps.command_executed: sudo iptables -I INPUT -j DROP && sudo iptables -I OUTPUT -j DROP
steps.notes: Host isolated immediately within 3 minutes of Wazuh alert. Outbound C2 beaconing ceased.

steps.title: Identify the Malicious Process and Encryption Parent PID
steps.notes: Found suspicious binary /tmp/.cache_updater running with PID 4892 encrypting /var/data/students/.

steps.title: Preserve Forensic Memory Dump and Volatile Evidence
steps.command_executed: sudo dd if=/dev/fmem of=/data/evidence/mem_dump_4892.raw bs=1M count=512
steps.notes: Evidence captured with verified SHA-256 hash before process termination.

steps.title: Terminate Malicious Process and Child Subprocesses
steps.notes: Process group terminated. File modification lock released.

steps.title: Block Malicious C2 IP Address at Perimeter Firewall
steps.command_executed: sudo ufw insert 1 deny from 185.220.101.5 to any
steps.notes: Perimeter rule injected. Drop rule verified across router syslog.

steps.title: Audit Database Integrity and Restore Affected Partition
steps.notes: 14 encrypted dummy student records restored from immutable snapshot taken at 03:00 IST.

steps.title: Generate Statutory DPDP Section 8(6) Incident Report
steps.command_executed: ZeroDashboard UI -> Click 'Generate Statutory Report Package'
steps.notes: Report compiled within 32 minutes of discovery, beating the 6-hour CERT-In statutory deadline by 5 hours 28 minutes.

recommendations: Enforce hardware token multi-factor authentication (MFA) on all SSH ingress bastions.
Isolate database subnets onto private VLANs without direct external Internet route tables.
Implement daily automated immutable snapshot backups with offsite air-gapped replication.
Deploy Wazuh File Integrity Monitoring (FIM) with real-time active response rules on /var/data.
